_note_offsets: JTX does not publish offset for the Dually Series — every product page says to contact a JTX salesperson. Offsets therefore come from f450-fitment.json (what this truck actually runs), never from this file.
_note_sizes: Verified identical across all five product pages on 2026-08-27. Front is the customer's choice of matched-narrow or wide; rears are always dual 8.25.
_note_finishes: JTX lists four finishes. We hold real per-finish renders for two; the other two are order-time options with no art, so the visualizer must not pretend to show them.
_note_art: Head-on renders straight from JTX, 2440x1974 RGBA originals cropped to the wheel and re-encoded as 900px WebP. Aspect of the opaque region is 1.000 — dead square — so the face circle is the bounding box and needs no fitting.
